As previously mentioned and contrary to popular belief, undernutrition/malnutrition is not simply a result of food insecurity.
Many children from environments that are food secure and from families with economic resources are below normal weight or have
short stature (stunting), due to inappropriate infant feeding and care, poor access to health care services or inadequate sanitation.
In many countries where undernutrition is widespread, food production is not the limiting factor, with the exception of famine
